title: Data Consent Framework
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Organizational Analytics
description: Interactive flowchart of the five components of meaningful data consent: Notice, Purpose, Scope, Access, and Recourse, with a feedback loop for scope changes. A scenario picker shows how each component applies to an organizational analytics project.

learningObjectives: Apply the components of meaningful data consent to organizational analytics scenarios
prerequisites: Difference between communication metadata and content
The principle that analytics should help people, not surveil them

controls.label: Scenario
controls.description: Choose the analytics scenario to apply the framework to

controls.label: Stage boxes
controls.description: Click a stage to open it in the detail panel; hover for an example

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Apply a framework to worked scenarios
keyQuestions: What does each consent component look like for this scenario?
What must be repeated when the scope of analysis changes?
commonMisconceptions: Telling employees that data is collected is enough without stating purpose and scope
assessmentOpportunities: Draft a consent notice that addresses all five components
Identify the trigger that requires consent to be refreshed
